Q5549.reason: The friend only feigned agreement and lacked the intent to commit or facilitate the crimes, so he is guilty of neither conspiracy nor accomplice liability.

Q5550.reason: The buyer impliedly promised to make reasonable efforts to obtain financing, and her complete inaction breached that promise.

Q5552.reason: The grantor's optional right of re-entry upon breach of the condition creates a fee simple subject to condition subsequent.
